-   YAML header will be in html in defelt that is good at viewing in a
    web browser but no on github

-   This in the output section of the YAML header will be good for
    looking at the document on github ouput: md_document: variant: gfm
    word_document: html:document

KNITTING - when you select knit a document togther and there are no
errors in the code you can generate an html doucment, a word document,
and/or a .md document.

R MARKDOWN AND CODE CHUNCKS - To include r code into your Rmarkdown
documnet you will need to insert a code chuck.

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
# we can set chucks to show up in the resulting document by setting some options like- {r setup, include=TRUE}
```

```{r}
# we can include code and plots into the code chucks

library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rmarkdown)

data("mtcars")
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(color = wt)) +
  xlab("Weight") +
  ylab("Miles per gallon") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "forestgreen", high = "black")
```

R MARKDOWN FORMATTING OPTIONS \# First-level header \## Second-level
header \### Third-level header - this allows different text sizes

You can do nutiple types of bullet-points - text - text

1.  text

-   text

2.  text

italic text '*ltalic*' bold text '**bold**'

IMAGES \_ you can embed images into the output. You will provide a file
path to the images from the current rmd file. For ease just put the file
in the smae direcotry as your rmd file. - if your forget the (!), it
will become just a link

```{r}
#![shrek and ggplot](IMG_8889-Copy.jpg)
```

TABLES First Header \| Second Header ------------ \| -------------
Content Cell \| Content cell Content Cell \| ContentnCell

```{r}
kable(head(mtcars, n = 5), digits = 3, format = "markdown")
```

When you click the '**knit**', it will render the document using the
existing syntax

Rmarkdown is not necessary for full reproducibility, but it does ensure
that someone downloading your code from github can understand what you
are talking about.
